messages.subject: Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "s")
parts:
Hi, I keep getting the following error in INLA, when previously it was working fine. 

I have tried uninstalling and reinstalling R and RStudio, and reinstalling the latest test version of INLA (I need this for the hurdle models I was running). I also have the same issue on my personal computer. Both are windows 10, both have been running INLA without issues until this one came up. 

Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "s") :
  File 'C:/Users/LKIRKP~1/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpmoDmHk/fmesher1e9453fb182d.s' does not exist.

I read that its linked to paths, so it seems that the path doesnt match to where INLA is installed? Any idea how I can fix this?

searchpaths() gives INLA in this location: 

 [1] ".GlobalEnv"                                                    
 [2] "C:/Users/lkirkpatrick/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.2/INLA"    

Thanks, Luci
